mechanism: Tranylcypromine (MAOI) can potentiate sympathomimetic effects and increase cardiovascular stimulation, elevating risk of arrhythmias in patients on digoxin; additionally, both drugs affect cardiac conduction and digoxin has a narrow therapeutic index.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, use with caution, monitor closely for arrhythmias, maintain digoxin levels at lower end of therapeutic range, and assess for hypertensive crisis or cardiac dysrhythmias.
